title: TIC annual survey — Foreign Portfolio Holdings of U.S. Securities at end-June 2026, FINAL report, 4:00 p.m. ET
source: EST: home.treasury.gov/data/treasury-international-capital-tic-system/release-dates-of-tic-data, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 111,181 bytes) by the tic-monthly-2027-02-18 initial-research adjacency sweep — its 2027 table's April row reads '30 - final' in the 'Annual: Foreign portfolio holdings of U.S. securities at end-June of previous year' column, with the Monthly column reading 15 and both quarterly columns empty. The page's own rule for this series, verbatim: 'Preliminary data for the survey are released on the last business day of February; the final report is released on the last business day of April', under the header 'All data releases occur at 4 p.m. Washington, D.C. time'. Corroborated mechanically at offset +0: the last business day of April 2027 is Friday 2027-04-30 (no 5 U.S.C. 6103 holiday falls in April), exactly matching the published cell — the same check that reproduces the sibling's 2027-02-26 preliminary date (02-28 being a Sunday). Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep: the proposer may not confirm what it found, only the event's own session may. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the tic-monthly-2027-02-18 initial research (2026-09-09) from that event's own primary fetch of Treasury's release-dates page. It is the OTHER HALF of tic-annual-survey-prelim-2027-02-26, which tic-monthly-2027-01-19 proposed after overturning three siblings' decline of this series — and the half that carries the settled numbers rather than the preliminary ones. Treasury's own note (d) pairs them explicitly, though in the retired pre-September-2011 regime: 'revised data back to the previous June was usually released in March to include preliminary data from the annual survey... The May release usually included the final results from that survey.' THAT DATING IS THIS PROPOSAL'S POINT, not a footnote to it. The 2027-01-19 ledger justified excluding February/March vintages from its revision test by the annual survey's benchmark feed; this session read note (d) and found that mechanism is documented as pre-2011, with the survey now reaching the monthly series through note (c)'s Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct editions. If that reading is right, the survey's footprint on the monthly series should appear at the APRIL revision edition (2027-04-15) and around this final report, not at February or March — and having both survey releases on the calendar is what makes that observable rather than arguable. Impact LOW and symbols empty on the standing grounds (16:00 ET is after the equity cash close, the reference date is end-June 2026 and therefore ten months stale at publication, no house playbook is macro-keyed). Note it lands two weeks after the 2027-04-15 monthly release, which is itself a Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct revision edition. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
